description: A gentler, more playful retelling that focuses on silly misunderstandings and comic mix-ups, keeping the mood warm and non-scary as Giske tries to figure out who she is after a harmless prank goes too far.
tone: Warm, whimsical folktale humor with a soft, reassuring mood
summary: After a harmless prank leaves her unrecognizable, Giske wanders from place to place causing cheerful confusion as she tries to discover who she is.
